sourceClasses.boundary: Current tenant identity, communication identity, locations, fixed roles, contact preferences, and accepted operating policy are facts only.
Only one reviewed provider-agnostic knowledge version/reference may be read; publication and projection remain Mission 21 authority.
Current appointment, assignment, dispatch, timing, and response-handoff facts may be read; scheduling and rescheduling remain upstream.
Current work state, field events, completion/reopening evidence, and accepted customer-update facts may be read; work truth remains upstream.
One exact current estimate, proposal, quote, commercial revision, response, expiry, or customer-safe document may be read; pricing and approval remain upstream.
Accepted tenant-private observations, recommendations, forecasts, alerts, evidence quality, uncertainty, and reviewed handoffs are advisory facts, never permission.
One exact current invoice, balance, due/aging, payment, receipt, refund, dispute, settlement, or reviewed collection-handoff fact may be read; financial truth remains upstream.

capabilities.boundary: View tenant-private internal action material within exact record scope.
Prepare one bounded no-external-effect internal action from one exact current source snapshot.
Create one in-app request for the tenant owner; creating it grants no downstream approval.
Tenant owner may decide one exact in-app request; the decision still cannot execute an unavailable downstream effect.
View one internal reviewed collection work item without customer, legal, provider, or financial effect.
Prepare one owner-only internal work item from one current Mission 27 reviewed handoff.
Unavailable in the first launch; no role receives this capability.
Unsupported permanently in Mission 28; no role receives this capability.

roles.boundary: Fixed tenant owner only; recent/exact authentication and later durable policy/approval authority remain mandatory where required.
Fixed tenant admin may prepare internal work and request owner approval but cannot decide owner approval or operate collection escalation at first launch.
Fixed tenant staff may view only an explicitly assigned internal action; no creation, approval, collection, recipient, channel, provider, or effect authority.

channels.boundary: Passive authenticated tenant UI only; no push, email, SMS, provider, or operating-system dispatch.
Existing tel, mailto, file, copy, or composer handoff stays manual and is never counted as a Mission 28 attempt, send, delivery, reply, or outcome.
No sender, consent basis, template, provider, deliverability, callback, or legal/provider review is accepted.
No sender, consent basis, template, provider, deliverability, callback, or legal/provider review is accepted.
Existing link creation/copy remains upstream/manual; automated recipient delivery is unavailable.
A callback may later be evidence after authentication/reconciliation; it is never a channel or authority and no provider is enabled.

recipientClasses.boundary: Exact authenticated owner in the same tenant and session/record scope.
Exact authenticated admin in the same tenant and permitted internal scope.
Exact assigned staff member may only view the assigned internal item.
No automated customer recipient is accepted at first launch.
No automated billing-contact recipient is accepted at first launch.
No automated lead/prospect recipient is accepted at first launch.
External collection, legal, credit, enforcement, or other widened recipient classes are unsupported.

countryRegionPolicy.internalBoundary: Internal passive actions may preserve the tenant's accepted timezone/region metadata but make no country eligibility, consent, or legal conclusion.
countryRegionPolicy.externalBoundary: No country or region is accepted for automated customer, document, financial, or collection communication until professional review is recorded.

consentBases.boundary: Tenant membership is internal product authority, not customer communications consent or a legal basis for external contact.

quietHours.boundary: No first-launch action may bypass quiet-hour evaluation by falling back to another channel or time basis.

languages.boundary: English internal labels are not acceptance of an external template, translation, locale, or legal meaning.

providerModes.boundary: In-app passive state uses no external provider, credential, callback, or transport.
Every external/provider path remains disabled and must fail closed without fallback.
No provider sandbox account, capability, credential, sender, template, callback, or evidence is accepted.
No live provider, recipient, message, document, collection, financial, or money effect is accepted.

legalProviderReview.boundary: The matrix is a product contract, not a professional opinion; unavailable review blocks external cells and cannot be inferred from tests or implementation.

rolloutFlags.boundary: Part 1D defines names only; it adds no flag, configuration, runtime read, or production mutation.

demoBehavior.boundary: Demo labels or interactions can never serve as paid, provider, delivery, outcome, consent, or legal evidence.

performanceBounds.boundary: The local deadline is a later functional acceptance bound, not hosted capacity, load, percentile, or SLA evidence.

migrationRules.futureRule: Additive reviewed migrations only after exact later-slice authority; no destructive rewrite, implicit legacy adoption, production SQL, or status claim without applied-history evidence.

launchCells.boundary: One passive in-app internal item from one exact accepted source snapshot; staff is view-only and no external or upstream effect exists.
Admin or owner may later prepare one in-app request, but only the exact owner may decide it and no unavailable downstream effect executes.
No first-launch customer communication is accepted because country/region, consent, quiet hours, language, provider, retention, and professional review gates are unavailable.

launchCells.owner: Mission 28 approved document-delivery policy over upstream-owned documents
launchCells.boundary: Existing secure-link creation/copy is not automated delivery; no first-launch recipient delivery is accepted without exact later authority and review.

launchCells.owner: Mission 28 approved reminder policy over Mission 27 financial facts
launchCells.boundary: No first-launch financial communication is accepted; exact billing-recipient, consent, legal/provider, retention, channel, and currentness gates remain unavailable.

launchCells.owner: Mission 28 human-controlled collection communication policy over Mission 27 reviewed handoff
launchCells.boundary: One owner-only internal work item from one exact current reviewed Mission 27 handoff; no customer contact, legal escalation, provider, financial mutation, or money effect.
No role, capability, source, channel, recipient, country, consent basis, provider, mode, flag, evidence, demo, or later Mission 28 policy may authorize this family.

unavailableEvidence: Part 1D independent audit, PR, merge, deployment, release, and runtime implementation
Production provider accounts, credentials, senders, callbacks, templates, capability, sandbox, deliverability, or live mode
Any automated customer communication, secure document delivery, financial reminder, external collection escalation, real recipient/message, provider effect, or live money
Professional legal, privacy, communications-consent, collections, debt, consumer-protection, country/region, regulatory, provider, or security review
Private-production customer evidence, hosted load or SLA, exercised disaster restore, physical Safari/devices, manual assistive-technology review, or founder visual approval
